title: Trial reprioritization: data ingest + UX evaluation plan
text:
Trial reprioritization: data ingest + UX evaluation plan

['From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aileen Park <aileen.park@brightcart.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Trial reprioritization: data ingest + UX evaluation plan

Hi Aileen — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and a proposed plan to keep the trial tight and measurable based on what you said today.

Recap from discovery:
- Primary business goal: reduce customer support search time in the storefront admin by surfacing intent-aware results and suggested replies.
- Two high-impact flows you want validated during the trial: (1) bulk data ingest / sync of product catalog + historical support transcripts, (2) in-app search/UX suggestions surfaced in the admin console.
- Constraints: sample dataset includes PII in support transcripts; you want minimal changes to BrightCart infra during the POC.

Proposal to re-prioritize mid-trial:
1) Focus sprint 1 (2 weeks): data ingest & mapping + end-to-end indexing into a sandbox. Acceptance = successful ingest of a 50k-row catalog + 10k-message transcript dump with schema mapping and no PII leakage to hosted logs.
2) Focus sprint 2 (3 weeks): UX evaluation in the admin console (A/B against current search). Acceptance = 15% reduction in time-to-first-relevant-result and qualitative NPS lift from test group.
3) Evaluation artifacts: we’ll deliver an evaluation matrix (attached) with pass/fail thresholds and test harness instructions.

Ownership suggestions:
- Redwood: Ben will own ingestion pipeline + sandbox deployment.
- BrightCart: Aileen / infra lead provide sample files, API access, and brief on redaction needs.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
- Aileen, share a representative data export (anonymized or with redaction instructions) by Tue 3/9. If you can’t, send a short sample and we’ll provide mapping guidance.
- Ben & I will prepare the ingest mapping template and run a quick validation in our sandbox (target Wed 3/10).
- Schedule a 30-min checkpoint after initial ingest to review logs and mapping (Thu 3/11).

Attachments: BrightCart_MVP_evals_matrix_v2.xlsx (evaluation matrix), sample_ingest_mapping.json (example mapping)

Thanks — I’ll wait for the sample and will block the ingest validation window once Ben confirms availability.

—
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0178
', 'From: Aileen Park <aileen.park@brightcart.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial reprioritization: data ingest + UX evaluation plan

Monica — appreciate the clear recap and proposal. We’re aligned on prioritizing the ingest first. A few notes: 

1) Data artifacts: I can provide a full product catalog extract (CSV) and a redacted subset of support transcripts (we’ll strip emails/credit-card-like tokens). If you need schema scaffolding, we’ll send a sample JSON by EOD Tue 3/9.

2) PII and compliance: we need to ensure the sandbox does not persist raw transcripts in hosted logs. Can you confirm Redwood’s sandbox retention policy and whether we can route logs to our S3 for audit?

3) Timeline: 2 weeks for ingest + mapping sounds good, but we should allow a 3rd week for remediation if the mapping uncovers schema mismatches (we have some legacy SKUs).

I’ll attach the sample schema in a separate message (security request) and loop in our infra lead if there are access questions.

Thanks —
Aileen Park
Head of AI, BrightCart
aileen.park@brightcart.io
', 'From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aileen Park <aileen.park@brightcart.io>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial reprioritization: data ingest + UX evaluation plan

Looping in on ownership and technical asks. Monica — I’ll own the ingest work as discussed. Quick clarifications and asks: 

- Please confirm whether BrightCart wants us to run redaction at ingestion time (we can strip email-like tokens/client identifiers) or if you prefer to deliver pre-redacted data. We recommend server-side redaction for reproducibility during tests.
- For acceptance thresholds: suggest we make the ingest acceptance two-tiered — (A) structural success: all required fields mapped for >=95% of rows; (B) functional success: sample query latency < 200ms on sandbox index for the 90th percentile. If that’s acceptable I’ll add those thresholds to the matrix and push a new tab to the drive.
- I’ll run a fast validation on Wed 3/10 at 10:00 PT — Monica, can you confirm you’ve blocked that slot? I’ll share logs to the Drive folder and link back to HubSpot.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/RDW-5421 (updated notes)

—
Ben Carter
Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
', 'From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aileen Park <aileen.park@brightcart.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial reprioritization: data ingest + UX evaluation plan

Thanks all — confirmation below and final re-baseline for the trial so we’re operationally aligned.

Confirmed timeline and owners:
- Wed 3/10 10:00 PT: Ben will run ingest validation in Redwood sandbox (Ben owns).
- Thu 3/11 11:00 PT: 30-min checkpoint to review mapping and logs (Monica to schedule; Aileen to invite infra lead if needed).
- Sprint window for ingest + mapping: 3/8–3/21 (includes a buffer week for remediation).
- UX evaluation window (A/B): 3/22–4/11.

Updated acceptance criteria (final):
1) Ingest: 
   - Structural mapping coverage >= 95% of rows for required fields.
   - No PII persisted to Redwood-hosted logs; any redaction performed is logged and auditable.
   - Functional: sandbox index 90th percentile query latency < 200ms for evaluation queries.
2) UX eval:
   - Quantitative: >= 15% reduction in time-to-first-relevant-result vs baseline.
   - Qualitative: average user satisfaction uplift on a 5-point scale of at least +0.5 from control.

Deliverables and artifacts:
- We’ll push an updated evaluation matrix to the Drive folder (same filename, new sheet with thresholds).
- Ben will upload ingest logs + sample mapping to Drive after the Wed run.
- Aileen: please provide an initial sample export (schema or redacted file) by EOD Tue 3/9 — if delayed, we’ll use the provided sample and document gaps.

Risks and mitigation:
- Legacy SKU schema differences — mitigation: include mapping rules and allow an extra remediation week.
- PII handling — mitigation: server-side redaction + S3 routing for audit; Ben to confirm retention policy in follow-up.

Next steps (action items):
- Ben: run validation Wed 3/10 at 10:00 PT and upload logs to Drive (action: Ben).
- Monica: schedule Thu 3/11 checkpoint and send calendar invite (action: Monica).
- Aileen: send sample schema/export by Tue 3/9 or flag delay (action: Aileen).

If everyone agrees I’ll consider this the official mid-trial re-baseline and update the HubSpot deal notes and evaluation tracker.

Thanks — looking forward to the Wed test.

—
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0178
